findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, fetch, cheapest_storage, best_value_storage, compare_prices, visible_promos, storage_near · Private data: search, fetch, cheapest_storage, best_value_storage, compare_prices, visible_promos, storage_near · Public sink: price_trends.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, fetch, cheapest_storage, best_value_storage, compare_prices, visible_promos, storage_near · Private data: search, fetch, cheapest_storage, best_value_storage, compare_prices, visible_promos, storage_near · Public sink: price_trends

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
